notes.title: Skyraine version 1.4.3 release
notes.notes:
New update!
 A few control changes: 
-Esc now brings up a menu to exit the game. 
-The '/' key is an alternate control to push crates.
We also adjusted the Normal difficulty to give more supplies, and added a few extra hints. In addition, we have uploaded some videos on how to beat the Easy and Normal difficulties to demonstrate effective base-building strategies.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TqczR0irF6c&t=2s         (easy)
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=n5j2NEcQFjk&t=65s      (normal)
These can also be seen on the videos page for the game.

notes.title: Version 1.4.1
notes.notes:
Thanks to everyone who has played Skyraine! We have already gotten a lot of useful feedback and have uploaded an updated version with a couple of changes:
The biggest thing is that there is now an in game overlay that will display the controls. This can be toggled on/off by pressing F1. 
We also made a few changes to the game description (that might help you out a little bit), to the start screen, and fixed a couple of bugs.
